TITLE: Kerr Holographic Orrery
DESCRIPTION: Physical Denisyuk/Benton beveled optical-glass hologram plate framing a recessed 3D celestial orrery orbiting a gravitationally lensing Kerr singularity. Features 12 live-wired performance controls across Geometry, Motion, Optics, and Performance, 5 factory presets, and a deterministic beat-synced QuickJS drift/shockwave script.

CONTROLS.NAME: speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Bipolar orbital and parallax velocity; negative values reverse Kerr spin and gyroscopic precession.

CONTROLS.NAME: audioDrive
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Scales FFT bass, mid, and high coupling into event-horizon breathing, ring expansion, and accretion filaments.

CONTROLS.NAME: lensing
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Gravitational spacetime curvature warping the relativistic accretion disk and deep holographic cavity.

CONTROLS.NAME: ringScale
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Expands or tightens the three concentric gyroscopic crystal rings and orbiting octahedral moons.

CONTROLS.NAME: mirrorFold
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Activates dual-axis kaleidoscopic hologram symmetry across the optical glass plate.

CONTROLS.NAME: dispersion
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Bragg diffraction grating rainbow spread across the dichroic rings and beveled crown-glass frame.

CONTROLS.NAME: glassGlare
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Front z=0 museum crown-glass diagonal gallery spotlight sheen, bevel highlight, and laser speckle.

CONTROLS.NAME: accentTint
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Chromatic accent wash shifting the Doppler accretion plasma and holographic Bragg spectrum.

CONTROLS.NAME: intensity
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Master HDR exposure driving ACES filmic bloom and Einstein photon-ring brilliance.

CONTROLS.NAME: strobeGate
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Arms beat-synced photon-ring strobe gating locked to chroma_BPM for peak-time drops.

CONTROLS.NAME: dropShockwave
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Momentary gravitational-wave shock pulse expanding from the event horizon with a spectral flash.

CONTROLS.NAME: tilt
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 2D off-axis hologram observer parallax (X = horizontal viewing angle, Y = vertical elevation).

PRESETS.NAME: Default
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Balanced museum-grade Kerr optical hologram with warm-to-cyan Doppler accretion and crisp glass bevel.

PRESETS.NAME: Deep Warehouse
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Slow ominous reverse Kerr spin, heavy gravitational lensing, low glass glare, and bass-heavy crimson plasma.

PRESETS.NAME: Peak-Time Strobe
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: High-velocity kaleidoscopic mirror fold with beat-synced photon strobe and hyper-dispersive electric cyan rings.

PRESETS.NAME: Iridescent Dream
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Gentle forward drift with maximum Bragg rainbow dispersion, lush crown-glass sheen, and violet-opal glow.

PRESETS.NAME: Sub-Bass Minimal
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Tight architectural orrery rings around a crisp black horizon with restrained glare and pure gold-white accents.
